start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:legal-pages-and-support for Harbor Coaching: write its terms, privacy and refund pages from my saved business facts and publish them." It reads record:business-setup:facts, writes the three pages marked not reviewed by a lawyer, publishes them and ticks the stage on your checklist.

no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Make sure your business facts row exists: record:business-setup:facts with business_name, support_email, first_offer_name and seller_return_url (the parent workflow:set-up-a-business-on-trillion writes it in its step write-the-business-facts).
2. Pour the example checklist and gap rows into the lists you keep for launch tasks and blockers (see pour), or make list:business-setup-checklist and list:business-setup-gaps from them.

3. Say "Run workflow:legal-pages-and-support". The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run and works the steps in order: read-facts, write-the-legal-pages, publish-the-legal-pages, name-the-support-address, record-the-stage.
4. Read the three documents it wrote and confirm each fact in them (every page is marked not reviewed by a lawyer); have your lawyer check them before you rely on them.
5. Open the checklist row legal-and-support: it says Gap while no live support inbox tool exists, and the gap row says so in one line.

worked_examples.title: Terms, privacy and refunds written from a coaching business's facts
worked_examples.ask: Write and publish the legal pages for Harbor Coaching from my saved facts.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/legal-document-builder/do-work/write-legal-documents.mjs: read-facts returned business_name "Harbor Coaching LLC", support_email "help@example.com", first_offer_name "Harbor Coaching", seller_return_url "https://harbor.example", and a monthly subscription offer; the step calls tool:write-legal-documents with documents ["terms","privacy","refunds"], has_paid_offers true, has_subscriptions true and reviewed_by_a_lawyer false.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"documents":[{"title":"Terms of Service","text":"# Terms of Service ... between you and Harbor Coaching LLC ... https://harbor.example ..."},{"title":"Privacy Policy","text":"# Privacy Policy ... Contact: help@example.com ..."},{"title":"Refund and Cancellation Policy","text":"# Refund and Cancellation Policy ..."}]}. The tool also flags each document as needing lawyer review, and names the facts still to confirm (for the terms: service_description, governing_law_state, venue, among others); those are gaps, never guessed.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
